dedupe_keys.name: hira hospital information service south korea open api of all medical institutions reported to the health insurance review agency

description: This API gives the national list of medical institutions in South Korea as reported to the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service (HIRA). Institutions report their details to HIRA under the National Health Insurance Act. The hospital information service returns institution records with an encrypted institution code that can be matched across HIRA services, and region and other codes documented in HIRA's open data system. It is free and available through the national public data portal as a REST API returning XML, after registering for a key that is approved automatically for development use (there is no bulk download file); the portal states the Korea Open Government Licence type 1, which requires attribution. Caveats: fields beyond those described on the portal were not read, institution codes are encrypted and cannot be decoded, and the HIRA open data site is rendered by script. Simulation uses: mapping hospitals and clinics for typhoon, flood and earthquake exposure analysis, locating emergency-capable institutions in response planning, and modelling access to care. Related records: the Japanese medical facility open data (data-mhlw-japan-medical-facility-open-data) and the US CMS provider data (data-cms-provider-data-hospitals) are comparable national registers.
